variants.specifics: Brackenford: Three townsfolk: a grumbler, a woman who wants Red Corwin hanged, a ferryman who teases.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Step aside! You ought to be out chasing those bandits, you slowpoke!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Catch that Red Corwin and hang him from his own tower!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: My, my! You're a lot cleaner than the last fellow who came through here! Drop by the ferry some day when you're done chasing bandits.

variants.specifics: Varrhold: Three townsfolk: Tamsk the ore-hauler, Orla, and Pibbet.

rumour1.speaker: Tamsk
rumour1.text: Out of the way! I've got ore to haul!

rumour2.speaker: Orla
rumour2.text: Keep your chin up, stranger, Ozrath's dead will crumble under our picks!

rumour3.speaker: Pibbet
rumour3.text: Oh, pardon me. That was my foot.

variants.specifics: Skeel: Wilka, Orra and Nella talk to the player in the walkways of Skeel.

rumour1.speaker: Wilka
rumour1.text: We'll hold the ladders here, but you must report to Mayor Pellam in the Town Hall. May your lamp stay lit through this long night, friend of Skeel!

rumour2.speaker: Orra
rumour2.text: Oh, it's you. Has the swamp been drained, yet?

rumour3.speaker: Nella
rumour3.text: I smell the stink of the grave on the wind! Will the dead ever leave us in peace?

variants.specifics: Gorst: Three townsfolk: Mirabel frets about the silent bell, Gribbin wonders about Zarrow, Hask praises the player after the Scorpions.

rumour1.speaker: Mirabel
rumour1.text: We're all to gather in the chapel when the bell rings, but who can ring a bell with no clapper? Good luck to you, brave Adventurer!

rumour2.speaker: Gribbin
rumour2.text: I wonder if Zarrow ever trims his beard?

rumour3.speaker: Hask
rumour3.text: So you're the one who squashed the Scorpions in Gribbin's wagon! Much obliged, stranger!

variants.specifics: Ombry: Three townsfolk: Mopsa cackles, Fennick saw an Ogre raft in the fog, Olm brushes the player off.

rumour1.speaker: Mopsa
rumour1.text: Swim, stranger, swim! Hee, hee, hee...!

rumour2.speaker: Fennick
rumour2.text: That Ogre raft just came out of the fog right under my very nose!

rumour3.speaker: Olm
rumour3.text: You've got the wrong boat, sorry.

variants.specifics: Merinth: Three townsfolk of Merinth: Hobbe the worrier, Rusk the drunk, Tilda the busybody.

rumour1.speaker: Hobbe
rumour1.text: We must hold fast and see Zorvan's Golems broken before they reach the College!

rumour2.speaker: Rusk
rumour2.text: Help! Help! He's asking me questions!

rumour3.speaker: Tilda
rumour3.text: Shouldn't you be out smashing Golems?

variants.specifics: Fort Vosk: Orwin on poor mad Hobb, Hilde teasing the player about the cold, Gorbo shouting about the Bats.

rumour1.speaker: Orwin
rumour1.text: I'm afraid poor Hobb has finally gone mad. They gave me his bunk in the barracks since he took to walking the walls all night howling at the moon and eating snow by the handful.

rumour2.speaker: Hilde
rumour2.text: I thought you adventurer types could take the cold. Try wearing a thicker cloak.

rumour3.speaker: Gorbo
rumour3.text: Help! The Bats are back in the brewhouse!

variants.specifics: Durgal: Three townsfolk: a smith who finds the Great Forge cold, a hothead about Bargul, a woman who teases the player.

rumour1.speaker: Smith
rumour1.text: WHAT? The Great Forge is... COLD?

rumour2.speaker: Townsman
rumour2.text: We must get the ore moving again! Drive off Bargul and take back the Smelting Pits.

rumour3.speaker: Townswoman
rumour3.text: You're awful puny for a hammer-man. Hah, hah, hah...!

variants.specifics: Pellor's Cross: Three folk of the hamlet: Moll on the Ogre Lord, Gimbo in her kitchen, Hask the wheelwright.

rumour1.speaker: Moll
rumour1.text: Bludgor would never have come down off his hills if Captain Vell had still been in town!

rumour2.speaker: Gimbo
rumour2.text: Hey! Don't you track mud through my kitchen!

rumour3.speaker: Hask
rumour3.text: I earn a fair living mending cart wheels.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK general-purpose agent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Vellin: Three townsfolk: Wendle points the way, Prissa brushes the player off, Pellow praises the bat job afterwards.

rumour1.speaker: Wendle
rumour1.text: Welcome to Vellin. The Town Hall is just up the road.

rumour2.speaker: Prissa
rumour2.text: I've got cows to milk, sorry.

rumour3.speaker: Pellow
rumour3.text: Good work with those bats, stranger! I hear Fennick is telling everybody!
